verdict.rationale: CDP's first-party webhooks docs describe real-time HTTP notifications for events across an integration, at-least-once delivery, and named subscriptions such as `wallet.activity.multi` covering up to 100 addresses. That meets the bar of registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: a full event-type catalog, payload signature verification and retry/backoff details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive real-time HTTP notifications when things happen across your CDP integration.
watch up to 100 wallet addresses under a single subscription with `wallet.activity.multi`.
